function updateBoxResults(unitId,announcement){const check=state.unitChecks[unitId],current=!inspection&&check?.snapshot===marking.bUnitSnapshot(state,unitId),results=current?Object.fromEntries(marking.bUnits.find(unit=>unit.id===unitId).slots.map(id=>[id,check.correct===check.total])):{},messages=[];for(const button of document.querySelectorAll('.answer-slot[data-unit="'+unitId+'"]')){const id=button.dataset.answer,marked=Object.hasOwn(results,id),correct=results[id];button.classList.toggle('is-correct',marked&&correct);button.classList.toggle('is-incorrect',marked&&!correct);button.querySelector('.answer-status')?.remove();button.setAttribute('aria-label',(isLocked('b',id)?'View completed structure ':'Edit structure ')+id+(marked?(correct?', correct':', step needs another attempt'):''));if(marked){const badge=document.createElement('span');badge.className='answer-status';badge.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');badge.textContent=correct?'✓':'?';button.append(badge);messages.push(id+(correct?' correct':' incorrect'));}}announcement.textContent=current?(check.correct===check.total?'Step correct.':'Check this step again.'):'';}

const panel=$('questionPanel');for(const item of answers('a')){const row=panel.querySelector('[data-reaction="'+CSS.escape(item.id)+'"]');if(!row)throw Error('Part (a) question row missing '+item.id);const field=document.createElement('fieldset');field.className='classification-row';field.disabled=state.complete.a;const legend=document.createElement('legend');legend.textContent='Classify reaction '+item.id;field.append(legend);const group=document.createElement('div');group.className='classification-options';for(const choice of ['oxidation','reduction','hydrolysis']){const label=document.createElement('label'),radio=document.createElement('input');radio.type='radio';radio.name='reaction-'+item.id;radio.value=choice;radio.checked=state.responses.a[item.id]===choice;radio.addEventListener('change',()=>{if(state.complete.a)return;state.responses.a[item.id]=choice;save();feedback();});label.append(radio,choice[0].toUpperCase()+choice.slice(1));group.append(label);}field.append(group);row.append(field);}

const addSlot=(answer,parent)=>{const button=document.createElement('button'),locked=isLocked(key,answer.id);button.className='answer-slot'+(locked?' is-complete':'');button.dataset.answer=answer.id;if(key==='b')button.dataset.unit=marking.bUnits.find(unit=>unit.slots.includes(answer.id)).id;button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(state.selected[key]===answer.id));button.setAttribute('aria-label',(locked?'View completed structure ':'Edit structure ')+answer.label);const label=document.createElement('span');label.className='slot-label';label.textContent=answer.label;const preview=document.createElement('span');preview.className='slot-preview';preview.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');const graph=state.responses[key][answer.id]?.graph;if(graph?.atoms.length)preview.append(thumbnail(graph));else preview.textContent='Click to draw';button.append(label,preview);button.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(state.selected[key]===answer.id)return;state.selected[key]=answer.id;host.querySelectorAll('[data-answer]').forEach(slot=>slot.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(slot.dataset.answer===answer.id)));loadDrawing();save();feedback();});parent.append(button);};

else for(const item of answers('c')){const node=host.querySelector('[data-c-slot="'+item.id+'"]');node.replaceChildren();const check=document.createElement('button');check.type='button';check.className='c-check';check.dataset.checkAnswer=item.id;check.textContent='Check';check.setAttribute('aria-label','Check structure '+item.id);check.addEventListener('click',()=>checkCAnswer(item.id));node.append(check);addSlot(item,node);}

function updateCFeedback(){for(const item of answers('c')){const id=item.id,check=state.slotChecks[id],locked=isLocked('c',id),current=check?.snapshot===marking.cSnapshot(state,id);const node=$('questionPanel').querySelector('[data-c-slot="'+id+'"]'),button=node.querySelector('.answer-slot'),control=node.querySelector('.c-check');control.hidden=false;control.disabled=locked||!marking.attemptedSlot(state,'c',id);button.classList.toggle('is-correct',current&&check.correct);button.classList.toggle('is-incorrect',current&&!check.correct);button.querySelector('.answer-status')?.remove();button.setAttribute('aria-label',(locked?'View completed structure ':'Edit structure ')+id+(current?(check.correct?', correct':', try again'):''));if(current){const badge=document.createElement('span');badge.className='answer-status';badge.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');badge.textContent=check.correct?'✓':'?';button.append(badge);}}}
